# Security policy

## Scope

The WikiLens Windows application (the installers published on the Releases
page and the source in this repository). Third-party wikis and the LLM
providers you connect are out of scope — report those to their owners.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting for this repository (Security tab → *Report a vulnerability*), or
e-mail <thiago@tenorio.cc> if that is unavailable. Expect an acknowledgement
within a week; this is a solo, spare-time project.

## Supported versions

Only the latest published release receives fixes.

## Known items

The whole-project review at `vault/2026-08-15_security-review.md` is the
ledger of what has been audited, what was found, and which below-the-bar
hardening items are still open.
